The eventual structural shell must remain host-flow-first across virtual-keyboard models. VisualViewport resize may schedule bounded verification but may not become x/y/bottom placement authority; Ghost must not edit viewport interactive-widget policy or opt the host into VirtualKeyboard overlay behavior. Because VirtualKeyboard is limited-availability, it is optional-only. Future structural-shell performance stress should separate deterministic hosted evidence from physical-device claims. Use Playwright Chromium CDP at 1x/4x/6x CPU slowdown with invariant-based correctness/resource gates and descriptive median/p95 timing only; CPU throttling is relative to the host and cannot certify mobile CPU architecture. Firefox remains a separate correctness lane because Playwright CDP is Chromium-only. Physical Android/AVD/WebView/GeckoView remain separate evidence surfaces.

Existing reviewed input/Send profiles are not structural-mount authorization. Future structural capability must fail closed when absent, reuse shared invariant/repair/teardown machinery, and keep adapter-owned structural discovery/insertion rules. Anchor-smoke selector health is lower evidence than authenticated structural capture, which is lower than mount certification. No non-ChatGPT adapter inherits ChatGPT's insertion rule by analogy.

A future structural Shadow host must add no new Trusted Types HTML sink. ShadowRoot.innerHTML remains TT-governed; current Ghost already proves that a restrictive trusted-types allow-list can block gitl-ui and drive existing HTML sinks to fail loud. Prefer a DOM-built in-flow host/Shadow subtree, preserve the named-policy boundary, keep MV3 structural mounting viable in the default isolated content-script world, and do not require MAIN-world/unsafeWindow authority. Browser TT support is broad in 2026, but host CSP enforcement remains site-specific and is not inferred for every adapter.

Open Shadow DOM isolates implementation/style but not UA UI-event propagation. Future Blue/Red certification must not assume clicks are contained: passive mount/repair stays zero-actuation, intentional Ghost activation must cause exactly one reviewed Ghost action and zero host Send/submit/native-control side effects, delegatesFocus stays false initially, mount/repair never autofocuses or steals editor focus, every Ghost button is type=button, and cross-portal ARIA IDREF relationships are accepted only when exact DOM/accessibility-tree evidence proves them.

Future structural certification should use a composable invariant ledger plus S1-S11 orthogonal scenario families and a small set of high-risk pairwise intersections, not one mega-fixture. Before judging a real A2 candidate, the harness must prove its own sensitivity by rejecting deliberately unsafe synthetic adapters for wrong-composer selection, Send identity/movement, overlay mounting, duplicate/stale repair, unscoped observers, incomplete cleanup, new TT sinks, focus/form side effects, inaccessible cross-root claims, and viewport-placement authority. A surviving mutant means the oracle is too weak; fix the test architecture rather than weakening product safeguards.

Hosted deterministic accessibility should use one locator-scoped Playwright ARIA semantic contract across Chromium and desktop Firefox plus exact focus, Send-node, role/name/state, and zero-actuation invariants. Chromium CDP AX-tree capture is optional diagnostic evidence only, while TalkBack/VoiceOver/NVDA/JAWS/WebView/GeckoView mappings remain separate certification surfaces. Playwright ARIA snapshots do not provide sufficient documented evidence to certify peer-ShadowRoot aria-controls relationships, so the first candidate must not depend on that relation without higher-tier proof.

Future Red structural certification must preserve two pre-existing user states: FOLLOWING_LATEST and READING_HISTORY. Passive Red mount/expand/collapse gains no new scrollTop/scrollBy/scrollTo/scrollIntoView authority; tests instrument Ghost scroll writes separately from browser/native scroll events, use direct scroll-owner/tail/history-anchor/composer geometry, predeclare only a 1 CSS-pixel rounding tolerance for deterministic scroll arithmetic, reject CLS as the primary intentional-expansion oracle, detect ResizeObserver feedback loops, and fail to rail if the live scroll owner or natural reachability cannot be proven. Adapter-owned spacer/layout mutation remains a later separately authorized alternative, not an implicit repair.

verificationSummary.repairConstraints: Generation/current-container revalidation before writes; one scoped MutationObserver and one ResizeObserver owned by the mount manager; callbacks schedule/coalesce rather than synchronously resize; the implementation suppresses its own Ghost-only reposition mutation to avoid self-repair loops; Shadow controls bind directly to supplied reviewed Ghost handlers; any verification failure removes only Ghost-owned structure and restores the rail.
verificationSummary.mobileReflowConstraints: Treat VisualViewport/keyboard geometry as verification input, not placement authority; support visual-only and layout-resize keyboard models; never change host viewport/VirtualKeyboard policy; VirtualKeyboard optional-only; gate at 320-CSS-pixel-equivalent reflow and 200% text; coalesce resize/orientation verification; fail closed when Blue/Red crowding or clearance cannot be proven.
verificationSummary.constrainedRuntimeConstraints: Tier A: Chromium-only Playwright CDP at CPU rates 1x/4x/6x, identical structural/safety assertions, stable mount/observer/listener/pending-repair counts, zero Send-adjacent actuation, clean throttle/session teardown, and descriptive timing only. Tier B: separate physical Android/AVD evidence when a device claim is required. Do not promote Pixel emulation or hosted CPU throttle to physical-device certification; do not attach CDP throttle claims to Firefox.
verificationSummary.crossAdapterConstraints: Reviewed actuation/input profiles do not grant structural mutation authority. Use three evidence stages: anchor smoke (no mutation authority), adapter-specific authenticated structural capture, then mount certification. Shared code may own invariant checks/repair/teardown, but each adapter owns structural discovery and approved insertion rules. Missing structural capability means rail-only. ChatGPT remains first proof target; Claude/Copilot are provisional next capture priorities only; Manus needs fresh structural corroboration; DeepSeek/Gemini need stronger re-review; Perplexity/Grok remain higher-ambiguity; matched-but-unreviewed hosts stay rail-only.
verificationSummary.compatibilityConstraints: Future structural shell must add no new Trusted Types HTML sink. The deterministic prototype uses DOM-created Shadow nodes and textContent, not shadowRoot.innerHTML. Preserve the existing named-policy boundary, avoid a permissive default policy, keep extension mounting viable in isolated content-script world, and do not require unsafeWindow/MAIN-world authority. Existing whole-product blocked-policy behavior remains fail-loud and is not reclassified as a current PASS.
verificationSummary.interactionAccessibilityConstraints: Shadow DOM is not an event-safety boundary. The deterministic prototype keeps delegatesFocus false, does not autofocus on mount/repair, and creates explicit type=button controls with local accessible names. The independent Chromium semantic harness passed the direct-callback and zero Send/submit side-effect case, but repository Playwright/Firefox accessibility semantics remain pending exact A2X execution.
verificationSummary.structuralConformanceConstraints: Use a composable machine-readable invariant ledger, S1-S11 orthogonal scenario families, and five high-risk pairwise intersections instead of one mega-fixture. The A2 prototype encodes fixed-position and unverified/hidden-container mutant rejection, and those mutant cases passed the independent Chromium semantic harness; broader oracle mutation coverage remains for exact A2X/Red Team. A surviving mutant invalidates the oracle, not the safeguard. Deterministic prototype success still does not certify the live ChatGPT insertion rule.
verificationSummary.accessibilityVerificationConstraints: Tier A uses one locator-scoped Playwright ARIA semantic contract across hosted Chromium and desktop Firefox plus exact focus traversal, Send-node identity, role/name/state, expanded-state, hidden-content, cleanup, and zero-actuation invariants. Tier B keeps Chromium CDP Accessibility tree capture diagnostic-only because the domain is Chromium-specific and Experimental. Tier C keeps TalkBack, VoiceOver, NVDA/JAWS, WebView, GeckoView, and other physical/platform AT mappings separately uncertified until explicitly tested. Do not use browser-specific expected snapshots as a default escape hatch for deterministic semantic divergence, do not auto-update snapshots unattended to bless a mismatch, and do not treat Playwright ARIA snapshots as sufficient proof of peer-ShadowRoot aria-controls relationships.
verificationSummary.redScrollReflowConstraints: For the first Red candidate, preserve user scroll intent observationally rather than correcting it: distinguish FOLLOWING_LATEST from READING_HISTORY using the verified live scroll owner; make no new Ghost scrollTop/scrollBy/scrollTo/scrollIntoView writes during passive mount/expand/collapse; verify tail/anchor/composer/Red geometry directly; treat native/browser scroll events separately from Ghost write authority; use <=1 CSS px only for deterministic subpixel/rounding arithmetic, never as a user-visible jump budget; keep LayoutShift/CLS diagnostic-only for intentional expansion; require bounded/coalesced ResizeObserver repair with no feedback loop; fail to rail on ambiguous/stale scroll ownership or lost natural reachability. Adapter-owned spacer/layout mutation requires a separate evidence-backed authorization if host-flow-only behavior fails.
verificationSummary.platformClaimLimits: Chrome Android viewport behavior does not certify WebView. Physical Android, Android WebView, Firefox-Android/GeckoView, real IME combinations, assistive-technology mappings, calibrated low-end-device performance, exact current live ChatGPT structural insertion, repository Playwright wrapper/full-suite behavior, and desktop Firefox behavior for the current A2 prototype remain separately uncertified until executed/tested.
